title: The Watchtower
subtitle: A long look at a block entity, hazard-taped
description: The anchor at the watchtower's top is charged and the expedition's
advice is to look at it for as short a time as the quest allows,
which is three seconds -- `timer: 60`, a `block_entity` observation
Its line is hazard-taped, `dash: hazard`, because the expedition
drew it that way on the map and the canvas is agreeing. The
counting-house has no tape and the sky has none; the road has
exactly as much as the road deserves.
